name: Inspect
tagline: An open-source framework for large language model evaluations
description: Inspect is a framework for frontier AI evaluations developed by the UK AI Security Institute and Meridian Labs. Inspect can be used for a broad range of evaluations that measure coding, agentic tasks, reasoning, knowledge, behavior, and multi-modal understanding.
pricingDetails: Open source (MIT license per github.com/UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai). "Install Inspect from PyPI with: pip install inspect-ai"
